notes: The main traps: duplicate detection missing despite past incident, vendor rate limits without throttling, data protection violations.
Quick reviews miss: capacity over-provisioning (20x current load), single-zone deployment for 99.95% target, timezone handling for quiet hours.
Cross-file reading needed: traffic CSV vs capacity claims, vendor limits YAML vs design, service targets vs data retention.
The incident report shows why duplicates matter - not just technical issue but user trust impact.
Cost sheet shows budget constraints but design has expensive over-provisioning.
Retry storm risk from unlimited retries without dead-letter queue.
